items.title: ANK-Projekt des Monats: Neue Lebensräume an Burg Vischering
items.one_liner: Coesfeld ecologically upgrades historic moats with swamp zones and floating islands to boost climate resilience.
items.why: Provides an empirical example of green-blue infrastructure and water management enhancing urban ecosystem service supply.
items.action: Review the specific design methods used for floating islands and water retention.

items.title: Climate change affects Modesto’s poorest areas the most
items.one_liner: Explores how climate change disproportionately impacts poorer urban neighborhoods and examines municipal responses.
items.why: Directly touches on environmental justice and the unequal distribution of urban ecosystem services like cooling.
items.action: Examine how municipal planners evaluate vulnerability and heat exposure across socio-economic strata.

items.title: Maternal mental health liveability shaped by environmental profiles
items.one_liner: Nature study highlights how composite residential environmental profiles shape maternal mental health liveability.
items.why: Supplies peer-reviewed evidence connecting spatial environmental exposure to human health benefits and well-being.
items.action: Read the study to understand its methodology for quantifying composite residential environmental exposures.

items.title: For COPs to Deliver: National Ambition Met with Local Action
items.one_liner: Argues that international climate agreements must connect national ambitions with local urban-level implementation.
items.why: Connects international climate treaties and policy frameworks with localized urban adaptation and planning.
items.action: Review mechanisms linking global climate frameworks to municipal action plans.

items.title: Developing green spaces for a livable capital city in Vietnam
items.one_liner: Explores strategies for expanding green spaces to enhance liveability in the capital city of Vietnam.
items.why: Provides a Global South urban context perspective on green space planning and urban ecosystem service delivery.
items.action: Compare Hanoi's green space expansion strategies with peri-urban challenges in Kabul.

items.title: A purple spring, a brown divide: Jacarandas and the politics of trees
items.one_liner: Examines the socio-political dimensions of urban trees and environmental inequalities in an African urban context.
items.why: Deepens understanding of environmental justice, unequal tree distribution, and the politics of urban nature.
items.action: Incorporate the article's perspective on tree politics into discussions on access to urban nature.

items.title: Expanding ecological industrial urban space at Ho Chi Minh City
items.one_liner: Focuses on expanding ecological industrial urban spaces at the southwestern gateway of Ho Chi Minh City.
items.why: Offers a relevant Global South case study on managing peri-urban industrial and ecological spaces.
items.action: Analyze how ecological zoning is integrated into industrial gateway expansions.

items.title: $357,000 grant transforms dirt lot into Wellness Garden
items.one_liner: A grant transforms a vacant dirt lot into a new wellness garden, improving local green infrastructure.
items.why: Illustrates how targeted funding interventions can convert degraded urban spaces to improve access to urban nature.
items.action: Check the funding mechanism used for transforming vacant urban spaces.

items.title: Commission launches consultation on easier product repairs
items.one_liner: The European Commission launched an evidence-gathering consultation open until February 2027 regarding product repairs.
items.why: Informs broader circular economy and resource governance frameworks linked to sustainable urban consumption patterns.
items.action: Note the consultation deadline for potential institutional review.
items.status_evidence: The evidence-gathering exercise is open until 9 February 2027 and will inform the impact assessment work for a possible delegated act.

items.title: Seoul's policy think tank guides global megacities on AI and policy
items.one_liner: Seoul's think tank shares guidance on integrating artificial intelligence and sustainable urban policy for megacities.
items.why: Highlights advanced methodological tools and spatial modeling approaches for sustainable urban policy.
items.action: Investigate how AI applications are framed for managing sustainable urban ecosystem services.

items.title: Science of a city: Maths, physics, ecology & psychology of urban life
items.one_liner: Discusses the multidisciplinary science of urban life, encompassing mathematics, physics, ecology, and psychology.
items.why: Aligns with foundational theories in urban ecology and social-ecological systems analysis.
items.action: Review multidisciplinary modeling perspectives on urban form and ecological functions.

items.title: Dubai's new urban development policy increases property values
items.one_liner: Dubai implements an urban development policy aimed at significantly increasing property values through planning.
items.why: Demonstrates the economic valuation dimensions of urban development policies and land-cover planning.
items.action: Review the economic drivers tied to Dubai's new spatial development policies.

note: Selected updates, not comprehensive coverage. Status is unverified unless supported by the quoted official excerpt.
